reader.requirement: At --std 85 a GENERATE report-name statement performs the subtotalling of a GENERATE data-name for the report's single detail (non-UPON SUM addends and SUM ... UPON that detail, repeated as written) without presenting the detail but running its USE BEFORE REPORTING procedure, or with no detail the non-UPON subtotalling alone (§1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR11, GR11a); the form is refused without a CONTROL clause or with more than one detail (§1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR2).

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002: a report description with more than one detail refuses GENERATE report-name (COBOL6823); from 2002 accepted

reader.edition-search: the subtotalling itself (GenerateCore's SUM loop with the sole detail's name from BoundGenerate.SummaryDetail) reads no edition; BindGenerate picks the sole detail at every edition
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: yes: p5c (two details) is refused at 85 and compiles at 2023, where no UPON subtotalling occurs for GENERATE report-name
reader.witnesses-cover: part: pb5249/pb5789/pb5337 cover the one-detail UPON subtotalling, the no-detail case and the detail's USE procedure; not exercised: duplicated UPON operands and duplicated addends under GENERATE report-name, a mix of GENERATE data-name and report-name, and the SR2 refusals

reader.notes: GR11 is a pointer rule; the substance is the GENERATE statement and TYPE GR11, both checked by probe. The COBOL6823 diagnostic cites §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR6 while the GENERATE statement's own rule is §1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR2b (both state the one-detail limit; cosmetic). Classes a, d, e, f do not apply beyond what p4b covers.

refuter.evidence: Read §1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR2a-c, XIII.3.20.4 GR11/11a and XIII.3.20.3 SR6-SR7. The reader did not probe SR2c (at least one body group). In r5a, a report with CONTROLS FINAL K and only RH and RF groups, plus GENERATE R1, is refused with COBOL2749 'describes no body group'. That is correct at 1985 because XIII.3.20.3 SR7 requires a body group in every report, so SR2c is never reached separately. Run r5a-001. cite.py: 'OK  §1985:XIII.4.3.3 SR2c  (4.3.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR2c'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.3 SR7  (3.20.3 Syntax Rules)  the text is in SR7'; 'OK  §1985:XIII.3.20.4 GR11  (3.20.4 General Rules)  the text is in GR11'. Edition sites: ReportWriterBinder.cs#BindGenerate line 404 (DialectLevel < 2002 detail count), as the reader listed.
